title: Consciousness Energy
definition: Consciousness as a form of energy, subject to the laws of conservation and transformation.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of consciousness as a type of energy. It can't be created or destroyed, but it can change form, just like other energy.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Consciousness is conceptualized as a form of energy, following the principles of energy conservation. It can be transformed but not created or destroyed.
difficulty_levels.expert: Consciousness is a philosophical enigma that can be approached through the lens of energy. This concept challenges dualistic theories and raises questions about the nature of reality and the role of information in consciousness.

extra_fields.insight: Consciousness can be viewed through the lens of energy conservation, transforming philosophical debates into scientific inquiries.
